sections.description:
Simple replacement with drag and drop!

Replace your media in WordPress quickly and easily by drag and drop! All image references are automatically updated, thumbnails regenerated, and image metadata preserved.
With neoReplace you keep the images in your media library up to date!

🏝️ Sandbox for neo Replace

Try neo Replace right in your browser without having to install it.

→ Start Sandbox

🚀️ Main Features of neo Replace

  • ✅ Replaces the image and correctly redirects image references 🎉
  • ✅ Easy file replacement via drag and drop
  • ✅ Replacer supports every format including images, videos, audio files and PDF documents
  • ✅ Direct integration into the WordPress media library
  • ✅ Automatically regenerates photo thumbnails after replacement
  • ✅ Preserves file attributes such as description, caption text and alt text
  • ✅ Reliably replaces images across the entire website
  • ➡️ Smart image replacer for the WordPress media library

Help and Support

  • WordPress Forum: https://wp.org/support/plugin/neo-replace
  • neo Replace Free-Support: https://neo-wp.com/contact/#free
  • neo Replace Pro-Support: https://neo-wp.com/contact/#pro

Get the Pro features

Find out what the Pro version of neo Replace offers to unlock the full potential of your media. ➔ What the Pro version can do

Installation & activation

Installation via the WordPress Plugin Directory

  • Open the WordPress admin > Plugins > Add New
  • Search for “neo Replace” and click “Install Now.”
  • After installation click “Activate.”

Install neo Replace from the official neoWP website

  • Download the Replacer plugin from the official website neo-wp.com.
  • Open the WordPress admin > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin > Activate Plugin

Manual installation of neo Replace via FTP

  • Download the Replacer plugin from the official website neo-wp.com.
  • Unzip the ZIP file and upload the neo-replace folder via FTP to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  • Go to the WordPress admin > Plugins > find “neo Replace” in the list and click “Activate.”

After activating the Replacer plugin

  • Click on “neoWP” in the sidebar of the WordPress admin to review and adjust the default options.
  • Adjust the “neo Replace” settings to your individual requirements.

Compatibility and Requirements

Minimum system requirements for the Replacer plugin

  • WordPress version 6.2 to 7.0
  • PHP version 8.0 or higher
  • MySQL version 8.0 or higher
  • Optimized for servers with Linux operating system (not Windows)
  • Server memory limit: min. 128 MB

Compatible plugins and tools with neo Replace

The neo Replace plugin has been tested with: Bricks, Elementor, Divi, Beaver, Oxygen, Breakdance, Gutenberg, WP Fastest Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, WP-Optimize, Autoptimize, Breeze, Cache Enabler

Legal notice about the Replacer plugin

The plugin neo Replace is provided free of charge and without warranty under the license “GPLv2 or later”. Use is at your own risk; liability for damages is excluded. Users outside Germany are responsible for complying with local regulations. This plugin may contact external services for licensing through Freemius (EULA, License Terms, Opt-In Information, Privacy Policy), updates, support and optional AI features. When using neoAI the selected image, the prompt and, if applicable, image title, adjacent titles, previous suggestions and page context are sent via neoAI to OpenAI in the USA or, when using your own API key, directly to the chosen provider. Personal or confidential data must not be transmitted. The connection is only made when an administrator tests it, retrieves a quota or triggers a generation. The terms and privacy notices of the service used apply: neoAI (Terms, Privacy), OpenAI (Terms, Privacy), Anthropic (Terms, Privacy), Google Gemini (Terms, Privacy), xAI (Terms, Privacy) and Mistral (Terms, Privacy). For custom and WordPress integrations the respective configuration determines the recipient.
Details about data, recipients, storage and third-country transfers can be found in the full privacy policy.
sections.faq:
Features of neo Replace

Which features are included in the plugin?

The main features of the Replacer plugin are:

  • ✅ Replaces the file and keeps references intact 🎉
  • ✅ Easy file replacement via drag and drop
  • ✅ Supports images, videos, audio files and PDF documents
  • ✅ Direct integration into the media library
  • ✅ Automatically regenerates thumbnails
  • ✅ Preserves description, caption text and alt text
  • ✅ Reliably replaces across the entire website

Short and sweet

What is neoReplace?

The plugin neoReplace is a WordPress plugin for replacing images, videos, PDFs and other media files directly in the media library. You simply drag the new file onto the existing file and neoReplace swaps it out.

Existing image references are automatically updated, thumbnails are regenerated and important metadata such as alt text, description and caption are preserved. This lets you replace media in WordPress without having to manually swap every image on pages, posts or in page builders.

Galleries supported

Are created image galleries preserved?

Yes, when renaming or replacing images, the image references in all common WordPress galleries are updated as well. Supported galleries include, for example: NextGEN Gallery, Envira Gallery, FooGallery, Modula Image Gallery, Photo Gallery by 10Web, Meow Gallery, Responsive Lightbox & Gallery, Visual Portfolio, Justified Image Grid, The Grid and many more.

How it works

How do I replace an image in WordPress with neoReplace?

With neoReplace you replace an image right where you expect it: in the WordPress media library. An action link appears on the existing media that opens the replace popup. After that you can either select the new file traditionally or simply drag and drop it into the popup.

After uploading, neoReplace replaces the file, creates appropriate new thumbnails and updates the existing references in your WordPress database. As a result, the new image appears automatically wherever the old image was used.

Updating references

Are old image references updated automatically?

Yes. That is exactly what neoReplace was built for. When replacing a media file, existing references in the WordPress database are updated so the new image appears wherever the old one was embedded.

This is especially important if the file name, the file extension or the image format changes when replacing. neoReplace takes into account content from posts and pages, post meta fields, WordPress options, ACF fields and data structures used by page builders, among others.

This reduces broken image links, faulty media references and unnecessary manual rework.

Supported formats

Which file formats can I replace with neoReplace?

With neoReplace you can replace images, videos, audio files, PDFs and many other media formats. All common file types that can be uploaded to WordPress are supported.

These include, among others, JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, SVG, GIF, TIF, BMP, MP4, MOV, WEBM, AVI, MP3, WAV, PDF, TXT and ZIP. For example, you can replace a JPG image with a PNG, WEBP or AVIF without having to reinsert the file on every page afterwards.

Metadata preserved

Are alt text, description and caption preserved when replacing?

Yes. When replacing a file, neoReplace preserves important media information such as alt text, description and caption. This is particularly useful if you only want to swap an image for technical or design reasons while keeping the existing SEO texts.

Optionally, when replacing you can choose whether the file name, title and slug from the newly uploaded image should also be adopted. This gives you flexibility to decide whether only the file itself is updated or whether the media name should be adjusted to the new file as well.

Regenerating thumbnails

What happens to WordPress thumbnails when replacing?

When replacing an image, neoReplace automatically creates new WordPress thumbnails. This regenerates the appropriate image sizes for themes, WooCommerce, galleries and page builders.

If the new image has a different resolution than the old one, the number or size of generated thumbnails may change. neoReplace maps the new preview images to the existing image sizes as sensibly as possible so your site can continue to serve appropriate image versions.

Page builders

Does neoReplace work with Elementor, Bricks, Divi and Gutenberg?

Yes. neoReplace is designed for common WordPress setups and page builders. These include, among others, Elementor, Bricks, Divi, Gutenberg, the Classic Editor and many more builders.

The plugin searches for image references not only in regular post content but also in data structures commonly used by page builders. These include plain URLs, JSON data and serialized PHP arrays. As a result, neoReplace can update images even where manual replacement quickly becomes confusing.

WooCommerce

Can I replace product images in WooCommerce?

Yes, neoReplace is compatible with WooCommerce and is well suited for replacing product images, gallery images and other shop media.

When you replace a product image in the WordPress media library, existing links remain intact and the new image can automatically appear where the old product image was used. This saves a lot of time, especially in larger shops, because images do not have to be replaced manually in each product.

SEO benefits

What benefits does neoReplace offer for SEO?

neoReplace helps you keep your WordPress media SEO-friendly and up to date. When you replace images, videos or PDFs, existing media references are updated and important image information such as alt text, description and caption is preserved.

This is particularly helpful when you replace outdated images with optimized versions, want to use new WebP or AVIF files, or update product images, portfolio images and landing page graphics. This avoids broken image references, saves manual work and ensures that your content is correctly embedded for users and search engines.

Preview where images are used

Can I see where an image is used before replacing it?

Yes, with the Pro version. neoReplace can show you where an image is used in posts, pages or database fields before replacing it. That way you can see where the new image will appear on your site before you make the swap.

This preview is especially useful for important media such as hero images, product images, logos, PDFs, portfolio images or images on landing pages. You get more control over the replace process and can better assess which areas of your site will be affected.

Neo universe

What is the neoUniverse?

The neoUniverse is more than just a plugin collection. It is your complete toolkit for all media challenges in WordPress. It currently includes ten specialized plugins: neoLibrary, neoRename, neoReplace, neoDuplicate, neoOptimize, neoLazy, neoDraw, neoAnimate and neoMotion. They work seamlessly together, are perfectly coordinated and cover all areas around media management, SEO and performance. Whether renaming images, replacing files, optimizing SEO, activating lazy load or drawing and animating content. The neoUniverse makes your media workflow noticeably easier and more efficient. And the best part: the neoUniverse keeps growing. New tools and features make your WordPress day-to-day even better.

Download with Safari

Why do I only see a folder when downloading?

If you use Safari, your Mac might automatically unzip the ZIP file. Instead of the ZIP file you then only get the unzipped folder. You cannot upload that directly to WordPress.

Solution: Open Safari settings and disable the option ”Open safe files after downloading”. After that the ZIP file will remain as you need it.

The video titled ”How to disable Safari auto extract for ZIP files when downloading WordPress plugins” on YouTube shows the exact details.

More questions

I have more questions. Can you help me?

Sure! You can ask us your questions anytime via our Support page. We will reply shortly.
